The trigger->post chain opens the hidden Wrapping dropdown first (runner has a single pre)

page.merge-shapes.note: ledger row: page.merge-shapes — Merge shapes ▾ Union stamps data-merge-op on the selected object (editor.js:3640); needs only one object pick, seeded by the ctx-menu-on-image pre; trigger->post chain opens the hidden dropdown

page.custom-columns.note: ledger row: page.custom-columns — Columns ▾ 'Custom columns' (data-cmd=openColumnsDialog, editor.js:1549) opens the same #columns-dialog as the visible Columns ribbon button

protect.protect-document.note: ledger row: protect.protect-document — honest gap: the Protect Document toggle (data-cmd=restrictEditing, editor.js:8360 toggleRestrictEditing) POSTs api('protect'), which 404s 'not found' for the runner's unstored demo.docx (editor_docs.rs document_protect requires store.get_content and lacks the demo_or_stored fallback its GET sibling document_protect_state has), so the handler shows 'protection failed' and editor.contentEditable stays true; verified live against the docserver binary

view.zoom-to-100.note: ledger row: view.zoom-to-100 — OO 'Zoom to 100%' binds to the statusbar #btn-zoom-reset; the click handler pins zoomLevel=1 and applyZoom (editor.js:10415/9527) writes editor.style.zoom='1' plus the 100% statusbar label

statusbar.btn-zoom-topage.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-topage — OO fit-to-page maps to the single statusbar #btn-zoom-fit; at the runner's 1600px viewport the handler zoomLevel=(1600-96)/830=1.812 -> applyZoom writes '181%' into #sb-zoom-label (editor.js:10419). Verified passing in isolation, but honest xfail at full-run scale: applyZoom persists wo-zoom=1.81 in localStorage and this row runs at manifest 235/236 directly before the order-fragile statusbar.btn-zoom-down/up contracts (view-flags.json, 237/238) that assume a clean 1.0 persisted zoom; the single-pre vocabulary has no zoom-restore step

statusbar.btn-zoom-towidth.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-towidth — same single WO control as btn-zoom-topage (#btn-zoom-fit fits the page width into the viewport, editor.js:10419; deterministic 181% at 1600px); same full-run-scale xfail reason: the persisted 1.81 zoom breaks the immediately following zoom-down/up pair (view-flags.json 237/238)
